summary: Frontend-only regression/resilience verification for the 502 red-box fix on GigTax (AU tax/expense tracker, Expo web preview). Executed the full happy path end-to-end with zero uncaught errors, zero red-box, and zero unhandled promise rejections. Flow covered: (1) fresh localStorage → 5-step onboarding (AU + NSW defaults → worktype-delivery → platform-Uber → ownership-own → skip recurring) landed on Home; (2) Home quick-add worked for Income $150.50 (entry-amount), Expense $45.75 (entry-amount), and Trip 12.5 km (entry-distance — the Trip route uses entry-distance, not entry-amount as the review note suggested); Net Earnings updated correctly to $104.75 ($150.50 income − $45.75 expense) and dollar values were rendered; (3) 3 recent-del rows appeared, deleted the first one — count dropped to 2 with no crash; (4) opened one of the remaining rows via recent-<id>, edited its value, and deleted it via entry-delete — modal closed cleanly, no error; (5) Trips tab loaded, business-use gauge rendered; (6) Expenses tab loaded (empty state); (7) Reports tab cycled through period-week, period-month, period-quarter, period-year — all rendered NET PROFIT card correctly ($150.50 for Year with 100% business default); (8) Settings toggled set-worktype-passengers/both/delivery, set-state-VIC/QLD/NSW, set-platform-DoorDash/Menulog/Uber, and theme-toggle — every toggle persisted through updateProfile without a single red-box; set-vehicle-save fired 'Vehicle details saved' toast; (9) tax-setup opened via set-tax-setup, tax-save fired 'Tax setup saved' toast, closed cleanly; (10) GPS shift regression: granted geolocation, tapped gps-start, simulated 5 coord updates (~200-400 m apart, 4.3 s cadence) around Sydney, tapped gps-stop (1.84 km accumulated), tagged Business via gps-tag-business — '1.84 km logged as business' toast and green Business badge appeared in History with · GPS marker. Instrumented page.on('pageerror') and page.on('console') for the entire run: 0 pageerrors, 0 error-level console messages, no 'Uncaught', '502: <!DOCTYPE', or 'Unhandled rejection' text anywhere. The api.ts retry+timeout wrapper, store.updateProfile null-safety, and try/catch toast wrapping in home/trips/expenses/entry/onboarding/tax-setup/settings all behaved correctly on the happy path.

react_native_issues.component: unknown (RN Web warning, still pre-existing from iteration_1/2)
react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning previously flagged ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.') was NOT re-observed in this run's error-only capture, but it was still present in iteration_2's full-console capture. Reference: shared UI primitive (Pressable/View wrapper). Cleanup still recommended.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: migrate remaining pointerEvents={...} prop usage to style.pointerEvents (carried over from prior iterations, not caused by this fix).

Nit: the review note said home-add-trip opens the entry modal with 'entry-amount' — actually it uses testID 'entry-distance' (Add Trip route). Consider updating the internal test spec so future test agents don't lose 5 min chasing entry-amount on the trip form.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts req(): 15s AbortController timeout + exponential-ish retry (800 ms sleep, max 2) for 502/503/504 and network aborts is correct and idempotent-safe for GET; POST/PUT/DELETE retries could double-write if the server actually processed the first request before the gateway returned 502 — worth a follow-up idempotency key on server, but for user-visible resilience the current behaviour is a big improvement and no double-write was observed during testing.
store.updateProfile now catches, logs, and returns null instead of rejecting — call sites (onboarding, tax-setup, settings.saveVehicle) correctly branch on null and show toasts. Good.
trips.tsx stopShift still safely wraps subRef.current?.remove() in try/catch (fix from iteration_2 preserved).
Trip 'Add trip' route uses entry-distance (not entry-amount) — small inconsistency with income/expense entry, but functionally fine and both share entry-save + entry-delete.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested regression paths — onboarding, quick-add income/expense/trip, recent delete, edit+entry-delete, Settings toggles (work type, region, platforms, theme, save vehicle), tax-setup save, Reports Week/Month/Quarter/Year, GPS shift Business classification. 0 pageerrors, 0 red-box, 0 unhandled rejections.

seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_ profile via localStorage.clear(). Byproducts: 1 income ($150.50), 1 expense ($45.75), 1 manual trip (12.5 km — later deleted), 1 GPS Business trip (1.84 km). Also toggled settings ended on theme-light + platform Uber+Menulog, work_type=delivery, region=NSW (last chip clicked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding: onboarding-next -> worktype-delivery -> onboarding-next -> platform-Uber (case sensitive) -> onboarding-next -> ownership-own -> onboarding-next -> onboarding-next (skip recurring). Quick-add on Home: home-add-income and home-add-expense use testID 'entry-amount'; home-add-trip uses testID 'entry-distance' (different field, same entry-save/entry-delete). Recent rows: recent-<id> to edit, recent-del-<id> to delete inline. Settings testIDs are prefixed set-* (set-worktype-*, set-state-* for region, set-platform-*, set-vehicle-save, set-tax-setup) and there's theme-toggle. Reports periods are period-week/month/quarter/year. Tax setup: tax-save + tax-close. Trips: trip-toggle-<id> flips business/personal, trip-del-<id> deletes; gps-start/gps-stop, gps-tag-business/gps-tag-personal. To reproduce the 502 red-box path deterministically for a future run, temporarily stop the backend via supervisorctl while a mutation is in flight — the api.ts retry should mask it into a toast; if it doesn't, that's the regression to catch.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (from problem statement, not reproducible now because backend is UP): a transient gateway 502 during a service restart caused fetch to reject inside store/settings/entry/trips fire-and-forget handlers, surfacing as an 'Uncaught Error 502: <!DOCTYPE html>' RN red-box. Applied fix in api.ts req() (15s AbortController timeout + 2× retry on 502/503/504 & AbortError/network), store.updateProfile (never rejects, returns null), and try/catch+toast wrapping in every mutation call site. Verified in this run: with backend UP the full happy path throws zero errors, and code inspection confirms every mutation is now guarded so a future transient 502 would at most surface an in-app toast, not a red-box.
